'''Exposed Copper Door''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from [[Copper Door]] +<br />{{MCW|Potion}}) and a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from [[Exposed Copper]]). See {{MCW|Exposed Copper Door}} for everything else.
